item.title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
item.description: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.
item.content:encoded:
Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.

item.title: Is America really that polarized? The answer might be a surprise
item.description: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.
item.content:encoded:
